text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer developed paragraphs with examples from sister, guitar, dance, drawing","quality":"elaboration","description":"This captures how fully an idea is developed with supporting detail and explanation rather than stated briefly."},{"evidence":"clear opener and repeated conclusion about students not committing to careers","quality":"organization","description":"This captures a more identifiable introduction, body development, and concluding wrap-up that makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"I will argue\" \"Since I was young\" \"In the future\"","quality":"cohesive devices","description":"This captures use of transitions and internal links that connect sentences and paragraphs into a more coherent whole."},{"evidence":"\"my sister is an example\" \"for example\"","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"This captures the use of concrete examples to justify claims and make them more persuasive."},{"evidence":"\"can change their mind\" \"regret doing it\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures somewhat more controlled sentence forms that are easier to understand despite errors."},{"evidence":"\"not only one thing\" \"there are many students at my age\"","quality":"lexical range","description":"This captures somewhat broader word choice and the ability to vary language across the essay."}]}
